title: 長文読解
subtitle: 読むこと｜パラグラフの構成・ディスコースマーカー・要旨把握
subject: english

stimuli.content:
Many people feel sleepy in the early afternoon. Some of them drink coffee, but there is another way to stay sharp: taking a short nap.

Research suggests that a nap of about 15 to 20 minutes is ideal. It can help us focus better and work more efficiently for the rest of the day. Some schools and companies have started to encourage short naps for this reason.

However, longer naps are not always good. If we sleep for more than 30 minutes, we may wake up feeling sleepy and slow. Naps taken late in the afternoon can also make it hard to fall asleep at night.

In short, a nap can be a powerful tool if we take it properly. Keep it short, and take it before about 3 p.m.
